title: FrontRow: redeploy so functions pick up the new key
_note: Step 3 of 3 for the FrontRow token 503 (2026-11-07). Netlify functions read env vars at deploy time, so a saved variable needs a new production deploy. Run with --tab <the Netlify tab from set-supabase-service-key> so no new tab opens. Prefill only opens the Trigger deploy menu; Mike clicks Deploy project. Checked live 2026-11-07: the menu items are [role=option].menuitem, Deploy project comes before Deploy project without cache.

steps.instruction: Click Deploy project (not the without cache one). Netlify starts a new production build of master.
